content: Table shows the results of the conducted experiments in NUBes-PHI for all the compared systems. The included baseline serves to give a quick insight about how challenging the data is. With simple regular expressions and gazetteers a precision of 0.853 is obtained. On the other hand, the recall, which directly depends on the coverage provided by the rules and resources, drops to 0.469. Hence, this task is unlikely to be solved without the generalisation capabilities provided by machine-learning and deep-learning models.
